description:
A graph spec that compares a camera image with a reference inside a region of interest and
        raises an alarm when too much of it changed (leaks, deposits, missing parts), with a dashboard.
        Starts on simulated images; replace them with the camera node. No equipment output.
        Example: compose_visual_inspection(width=64, height=48, roi=[8, 8, 32, 24]).

affected_fraction_alarm.description: Fraction of changed pixels (0 to 1) that raises an alarm.
affected_fraction_alarm.title: Affected Fraction Alarm

asset_path.description: Asset hierarchy path of the inspected equipment.
asset_path.title: Asset Path

baseline_value.description: Gray level (0 to 1) of the simulated reference image.
baseline_value.title: Baseline Value

current_value.description: Gray level (0 to 1) of the simulated current image.
current_value.title: Current Value

delta_threshold.description: Change in gray level (0 to 1) that marks a pixel as changed.
delta_threshold.title: Delta Threshold

height.description: Height of the inspected image in pixels.
height.title: Height

roi.description: Region of interest [x, y, width, height] in pixels; omit for the whole image.
roi.title: Roi

width.description: Width of the inspected image in pixels.
width.title: Width

name: compose_visual_inspection
title: Compose camera visual inspection
